summary: Applied the triaged repair by defining the exact upgrade-required source path set and checkedPaths comparison semantics in the spec.

items.title: Upgrade-required source set is not concrete enough for gate validation
items.rationale: The spec now names UPGRADE_REQUIRED_SOURCE_PATTERNS explicitly and defines checkedPaths as the sorted unique matched file paths from the baseBranch...HEAD diff, which lets gate and tests compute the same stale-artifact comparison.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[0].desc defines checkedPaths semantics, requirements[2].desc names the full UPGRADE_REQUIRED_SOURCE_PATTERNS set, requirements[3].desc requires exact set equality, and overview.decisions documents both the source set and checkedPaths meaning.
